title: Team weekly report (AI)
description: AI reviews the whole team's week: the most common problems, who improved, how it compares with last week and an idea for a sharing session.
privateNote: Uses your own API key. The AI only receives aggregated numbers with anonymous ids, no prompts and no names; names in the result are filled in by the system. The result is visible only to you.
addKey: Add an AI API key to write the team weekly report
footer: Visible only to whoever ran it

errors.no_week_data: The project has no session in the selected week.
errors.llm_key_invalid: The AI provider rejected the API key.
errors.llm_model_not_found: The selected model does not exist.
errors.llm_quota_exceeded: Quota exhausted or rate limited at the AI provider. Try again later.
errors.llm_timeout: The AI took too long to respond (over 60 seconds). Try again later.
errors.llm_provider_error: Could not reach the AI provider. Try again later.
errors.llm_bad_output: The AI returned a badly formatted result. Retry or pick a stronger model.
errors.validation_error: The selected week is not valid.
errors.forbidden: Only a leader can write the team weekly report.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong running AI. Try again later.
